spans.s:
सोदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having or containing water.
 E. स with, उदक water.

सोदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Accumulated, augmented, with interest, with
profit.
 E. स for सह with, उदय increase.

सोदर m. (-रः) A brother of whole blood.
 f. (-रा) Uterine sister.
 E. स for
समान common, same, उदर belly, or womb.

सोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood.
 E. स for समान same or
common, उदर belly, यत् aff.

सोद्योग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Active, diligent, persevering.
 E. स with, उद्योग- effort.
